implementation.name: T80
implementation.notes: license_id deliberately omitted. The repository has no LICENSE or COPYING file; the terms live in the per-file header, e.g. https://github.com/mist-devel/T80/blob/master/T80.vhd: Daniel Wallner's notice permits "use in source and synthezised forms" under three BSD-style conditions. Because it substitutes "synthesized" for BSD-3-Clause's "binary", it does not match the SPDX BSD-3-Clause template and no SPDX id can be asserted honestly. accuracy_id from the same header, which describes T80(c) as an "Attempt to finish all undocumented features and provide accurate timings" and records ZEXDOC/ZEXALL/Z80Full/Z80memptr passes with SCF/CCF X/Y flags still unresolved. i8080 is linked because the repo ships T8080se.vhd, an 8080 mode wrapper (a Game Boy mode, GBse.vhd, is also present but that CPU is not catalogued).
